title: MemoryEpochCommit
description: Phase 0 commitment to a memory epoch blob without revealing contents. Chain via prev_commit. Privacy layer (ZKP/SD) can later prove membership/consent without opening the vessel. See ZKP/README.md §2.

principal_commitment.description: Commitment to principal (preferred over clear principal_id for outward proofs).

prev_commit.description: Previous epoch commit hash for chain integrity; null for genesis epoch.

commit.description: Hash/commitment of encrypted epoch payload + metadata.

store_ops.description: Optional count of store ops in epoch (no content).

recall_ops.description: Optional count of recall ops in epoch (no content).

population.description: Shaliah primary for Phase 0 memory vessel.
